title: RMBench: Memory-Dependent Robotic Manipulation Benchmark with Insights into Policy Design
abstract: arXiv:2603.01229v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Robotic manipulation policies have made rapid progress in recent years, yet most existing approaches give limited consideration to memory capabilities. Consequently, they struggle to solve tasks that require reasoning over historical observations and maintaining task-relevant information over time, which are common requirements in real-world manipulation scenarios. Although several memory-aware policies have been proposed, systematic evaluation of memory-dependent manipulation remains underexplored, and the relationship between architectural design choices and memory performance is still not well understood. To address this gap, we introduce RMBench, a simulation benchmark comprising 9 manipulation tasks that span multiple levels of memory complexity, enabling systematic evaluation of policy memory capabilities. We further propose Mem-0, a modular manipulation policy with explicit memory components designed to support controlle

translated_title: RMBench：具有策略设计洞见的记忆依赖型机器人操作基准测试
translated_abstract: 机器人操作策略近年来取得了快速进展，但大多数现有方法对记忆能力的考虑十分有限。因此，它们难以解决需要对历史观测进行推理并长期维持任务相关信息的任务，而这些需求在真实世界的操作场景中十分常见。尽管已有一些具备记忆感知的策略被提出，但针对记忆依赖型操作的系统性评估仍然不足，架构设计选择与记忆性能之间的关系也尚未被充分理解。为填补这一空白，我们提出了RMBench，这是一个包含9个操作任务的仿真基准，涵盖多个记忆复杂度层级，能够对策略的记忆能力进行系统性评估。我们进一步提出了Mem-0，这是一种具有显式记忆组件的模块化操作策略，旨在支持可控的（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出包含9个不同记忆复杂度操作任务的仿真基准RMBench，用于系统评估机器人策略的记忆能力，并推出带显式记忆组件的模块化操作策略Mem-0，为记忆相关策略设计提供洞见。
